Context: Transactions

ln both the cases, if the transaction is with a person having official dealings with the employee, previous sanction of the prescribed authority is necessary. - Rule 18 (2} and (3).  
Movable property includes  
- (a)
- Jewellery.
- Insurance Policies, the annual premia of which exceeds two months
- (b) basic pay of the Government servant.
- (c) Shares, Securities and Debentures.
- (d)
- Loans advanced or taken by such employees, whether secured or
- (e)
- not.
